newsitem.title: USA: Carolina to buy Lowcountry for $13.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Carolina to buy Lowcountry for $13.3 mln.

text.p: Carolina First Corp said Thursday it agreed to acquire closely held Lowcountry Savings Bank for about $13.3 million in cash and stock.
Carolina First plans to merge Lowcountry into its Carolina First Bank subsidiary.
The transaction, which is subject to the receipt of regulatory and Lowcountry shareholder approval, is expected to be completed in the second quarter of 1997.
Carolina First said of $13.3 million purchase price, 60 percent is payable in Carolina First common stock and 40 percent is payable in cash.
The anticipated exchange ratio for the 60 percent of the purchase price payable with Carolina First stock is 0.9377 Carolina First share for each Lowcountry share.
The purchase price per Lowcountry common share is $14.75. Lowcountry has about 300 stockholders.
Lowcountry has five offices in the greater Charleston area, and at December 31, 1996, had approximately $76 million in assets and $62 million in deposits.
